class.name: OcgSelectmgrSelectingvolumemanager
class.brief_description: This class is used to switch between active selecting volumes depending on selection type chosen by the user. The sample of correct selection volume initialization procedure:

method.name: SelectMgr_SelectingVolumeManager
method.description: Creates instances of all available selecting volume types

method.name: InitPointSelectingVolume
method.description: Creates, initializes and activates rectangular selecting frustum for point selection

method.name: InitBoxSelectingVolume
method.description: Creates, initializes and activates rectangular selecting frustum for box selection

method.name: InitPolylineSelectingVolume
method.description: Creates, initializes and activates set of triangular selecting frustums for polyline selection

method.name: InitAxisSelectingVolume
method.description: Creates and activates axis selector for point selection

method.name: InitSelectingVolume
method.description: Sets as active the custom selecting volume

method.name: BuildSelectingVolume_1
method.description: Builds previously initialized selecting volume.

method.name: ActiveVolume
method.description: Returns active selecting volume that was built during last run of OCCT selection mechanism

method.name: ScaleAndTransform
method.description: IMPORTANT: Scaling makes sense only for frustum built on a single point! Note that this method does not perform any checks on type of the frustum.

method.name: CopyWithBuilder
method.description: Returns a copy of the selecting volume manager and its active frustum re-constructed using the passed builder. Builder is an argument that represents corresponding settings for re-constructing transformed frustum from scratch.

method.name: Camera
method.description: Returns current camera definition.

method.name: SetCamera
method.description: Updates camera projection and orientation matrices in all selecting volumes Note: this method should be called after selection volume building else exception will be thrown

method.name: SetViewport
method.description: Updates viewport in all selecting volumes Note: this method should be called after selection volume building else exception will be thrown

method.name: SetPixelTolerance
method.description: Updates pixel tolerance in all selecting volumes Note: this method should be called after selection volume building else exception will be thrown

method.name: WindowSize
method.description: Returns window size

method.name: SetWindowSize
method.description: Updates window size in all selecting volumes Note: this method should be called after selection volume building else exception will be thrown

method.name: OverlapsPoint_1
method.description: Intersection test between defined volume and given point

method.name: DistToGeometryCenter
method.description: Measures distance between 3d projection of user-picked screen point and given point theCOG

method.name: DetectedPoint
method.description: Calculates the point on a view ray that was detected during the run of selection algo by given depth. Throws exception if active selection type is not Point.

method.name: AllowOverlapDetection
method.description: If theIsToAllow is false, only fully included sensitives will be detected, otherwise the algorithm will mark both included and overlapped entities as matched

method.name: ViewClipping
method.description: Return view clipping planes.

method.name: ObjectClipping
method.description: Return object clipping planes.

method.name: SetViewClipping_1
method.description: Copy clipping planes from another volume manager.

method.name: ViewClipRanges
method.description: Return clipping range.

method.name: SetViewClipRanges
method.description: Set clipping range.

method.name: GetNearPickedPnt
method.description: Valid only for point and rectangular selection. Returns projection of 2d mouse picked point or projection of center of 2d rectangle (for point and rectangular selection correspondingly) onto near view frustum plane

method.name: GetFarPickedPnt
method.description: Valid only for point and rectangular selection. Returns projection of 2d mouse picked point or projection of center of 2d rectangle (for point and rectangular selection correspondingly) onto far view frustum plane

method.name: GetViewRayDirection
method.description: Valid only for point and rectangular selection. Returns view ray direction

method.name: IsScalableActiveVolume
method.description: Checks if it is possible to scale current active selecting volume

method.name: GetMousePosition
method.description: Returns mouse coordinates for Point selection mode.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
